title: HF 2890 (companion; law = SF 2909, Ch. 52) (2023) — Omnibus judiciary/public safety finance and policy bill with Article 13 (firearms background checks, private-party transfers) and Article 14 (extreme risk protection orders), plus 18 other articles
operative_text:
Art 1 Judiciary appropriations: JUDICIARY APPROPRIATIONS
Art 2 Public safety appropriations: PUBLIC SAFETY APPROPRIATIONS
Art 3 Judiciary policy: JUDICIARY POLICY
Art 4 General crimes: GENERAL CRIMES
Art 5 Public safety and crime victims: PUBLIC SAFETY AND CRIME VICTIMS
Art 6 Sentencing: SENTENCING
Art 7 Expungement: EXPUNGEMENT
Art 8 Clemency reform: CLEMENCY REFORM
Art 9 Evidence gathering and reporting: EVIDENCE GATHERING AND REPORTING
Art 10 Policing and private security: POLICING AND PRIVATE SECURITY
Art 11 Corrections policy: CORRECTIONS POLICY
Art 12 Minnesota Rehabilitation and Reinvestment Act: MINNESOTA REHABILITATION AND REINVESTMENT ACT
Art 13 Firearms background checks: FIREARMS BACKGROUND CHECKS
Art 14 Extreme risk protection orders: EXTREME RISK PROTECTION ORDERS
Art 15 Controlled substances policy: CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES POLICY
Art 16 Controlled substances schedules: CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES SCHEDULES
Art 17 Community supervision reform: COMMUNITY SUPERVISION REFORM
Art 18 Supervised release board; life sentences: SUPERVISED RELEASE BOARD; LIFE SENTENCES FOR CERTAIN OFFENDERS
Art 19 Civil law: CIVIL LAW
Art 20 Carjacking; conforming changes: CARJACKING; CONFORMING CHANGES
Art 13 sec 3 private-party transfers background check (new section 624.7134, read from rendered page 284, all underlined = new): An unlicensed person is prohibited from transferring a pistol or semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to any other unlicensed person, unless: (1) the transfer is made through a firearms dealer as provided for in subdivision 3; or (2) the transferee presents a valid transferee permit
Art 13 sec 1 transferee permit (624.7131 amended): Any person may apply for a transferee permit by providing the following information in writing to the chief of police
Art 13 sec 2 (624.7132 amended, transfer reports): Sec. 2. Minnesota Statutes 2022, section 624.7132, is amended to read:
Art 14 sec 6 red-flag transfer of firearms (624.7175): upon issuance of an extreme risk protection order, the court shall direct the respondent to transfer any firearms the person possesses as soon as reasonably practicable, but in no case later than 24 hours
Art 14 sec 11 federal Byrne grant: Sec. 11. FEDERAL BYRNE STATE CRISIS INTERVENTION PROGRAM.
Art 2 firearm storage grants (appropriation): $250,000 the first year is for grants to local or state law enforcement agencies to support the safe and secure storage of firearms owned by persons subject to extreme risk protection orders.
Art 2 firearm eligibility check funding: $70,000 the first year is to purchase and integrate information technology hardware and software necessary to process additional firearms eligibility background checks.
Art 4 sec 15 machine gun definitions (609.67): "Machine gun" means any firearm designed to discharge, or capable of discharging automatically more than once by a single function of the trigger.
